name: Volumetric Path Tracing with BSSRDF and Medium Sampling
aliases: Path Tracing with Subsurface Scattering and Participating Media
Subsurface Scattering Integration in Volumetric Path Tracing
summary: This method extends volumetric path tracing by integrating BSSRDF probes into the path loop to handle subsurface scattering, distinct from standard volume tracing by treating subsurface exit as a surface interaction.
